name: Drained By Design
rootCause: A $550K lesson - Coinbase lost funds after granting ERC-20 approvals to 0xProject's permissionless Settler contract - exactly what their docs warn against. An MEV bot exploited the permissions to drain hundreds of tokens, adding to ongoing security failures investigators have highlighted.
